text:
marta: Quick heads-up — planning to roll v2 /v2/generate for EU tonight in the 22:00-02:00 UTC change window. Need a preflight client-probe run and confirm release notes are up to date. Who's on-call? :eyes:

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window 2026-03-20T22:00Z -> 2026-03-21T02:00Z. Canary plan: 1% -> 10% after 15m -> 50% after 60m -> 100% after 3h. Auto-rollback thresholds: 5xx > 1% or p95 latency > 300ms or error-rate delta > 0.5%. :robot_face:

mike: I'll run the client-probe from the EU staging cluster at 21:15. Sharing probe script in thread.

mike:
```
# simple compatibility probe
for t in $(seq 1 50); do
  curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/v2/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $PROBE_TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"test","max_tokens":10}' | jq '.choices[0].text' || echo "fail"
  sleep 0.5
done
```

priya: Note mobile SDKs still send `X-Client-Version: 1.x` for some old clients. We should add header-based canary routing to keep those on v1 until 2026-04-15. Otherwise risk schema mismatch for function-calls.

sam: Agree. Add a header gate: if `X-Client-Version` startswith `1.` -> route to /v1. Exec plan: deploy proxy update with header shim + traffic split.

devex: Release notes draft: https://docs.internal/release-notes/2026-03-21-v2-rollout (please fill compat caveats). Also add migration snippet for SDKs.

marta: Decision: Add header shim, run probe, then flip canary 1% at 22:00. If probe shows any `missing_field` or JSON schema errors, pause and roll back to the previous config. Priya, can you prepare the pinlist for mobile tenants vulnerable to schema changes?

priya: On it. Will push a tenant-pinlist to deploybot: `deploybot pin add tenant:mob-* until 2026-04-15` and share here.

deploy-bot: pinlist updated: 23 tenants pinned. Canary scheduled. Will notify at each ramp step. :white_check_mark:

mike: Running probe now against the canary proxy. 25/50 succeeded, 25 timeouts showing increased p95 on region. Re-running with longer timeout to check.

marta: Hold on ramp. If p95 stays > 220ms after 10m, we abort. Sam please stand by to rollback proxy change.

sam: Ready — rollback playbook: `deploybot rollback proxy v2-header-shim --reason "p95-regression"`. Ops-runbook on-call notified.

priya: Pinlist push completed and documented in release notes page. Also added snippet for SDK fallback to `v1` if server returns `420-schema-mismatch` error.

marta: Final: do not force full traffic until 02:00 and only after stable 60m at 50% with error < 0.2%. If anything hits thresholds, deploy-bot auto-rolls back and we do postmortem. :rocket:
